label: Ollama
description: Local models on your machine, no key
agentGuide: Local models, no key. Installed models: GET /api/tags (models[].name, size); one: POST /api/show {"model": "llama3.2"}. Chat: POST /api/chat {"model": "llama3.2", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "..."}], "stream": false} (message.content) — always "stream": false, the relay reads one answer. Completion: POST /api/generate {"model": "...", "prompt": "...", "stream": false}; JSON output: add "format": "json". Embeddings: POST /api/embed {"model": "nomic-embed-text", "input": "..."}. Pull a model: POST /api/pull {"model": "...", "stream": false} (long; asks for confirmation). Running models: GET /api/ps. Also OpenAI-shaped at /v1/chat/completions. A big model takes seconds to tens of seconds to answer.
